messages:
Sam: Hey team — I have a migration guide PR (#4821) ready to merge but the docs preview link is 404 and the docs-preview CI is failing.
Sam: Repro steps: opened the preview, got a 404, and the `docs-preview` job shows `Artifact not found`.
Sam: Can someone pick up review/merge? I can hold for the merge-window at 16:00 PT but it's a small fix.
docs-bot: docs-preview job failed for PR #4821 — see logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/98765 :warning:
Anya: I'll take a look in 15m, ping me if it hits the merge window.
Mike: If it's just a broken link in the static site build, usually rerunning the preview job fixes it. Try: `./ci/retry_build.sh 98765`.
Sam: Tried that, still errors with `Artifact not found` in s3://redwood-docs-previews/4821/
luis: Hmm, that's the region replication bug we saw last month. Maybe the preview job tried to checksum a file before upload.
Jen: @Anya @Mike if you don't get to it, I can slot it into the 16:00 merge window and do the quick fix + merge.
Anya: I can start now. Checking logs: there's a `NoSuchKey` when fetching `index.html` from preview artifact storage.
Anya: Looks like the build step wrote to a temp dir and the upload step used a different path — small path bug in the pipeline.
Anya: Patch is a one-line fix in `.github/workflows/docs-preview.yml` — changing `upload_path: build/site` -> `upload_path: site`.
Sam: Nice. Any QA needed? The content change is just an example migration note and a code snippet tweak.
Anya: Quick smoke preview passes locally. I'll push the fix to the PR branch and retrigger preview.
docs-bot: docs-preview job succeeded for PR #4821 — preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-4821 :tada:
Mike: LGTM — left a review. Code snippet render looks good.
Anya: Approved and merged during the 16:00 merge window. Thanks @Sam for the quick turnaround.
Sam: Thanks all! Can someone note this in the reviewer-coverage rota? We had no one on quick merge shift today.
luis: Filing a one-off reminder in the rota: https://go/redwood/rota — I'll add an opt-in for quick-merge shifts.
Jen: Also adding a short runbook entry in docs/ops about preview artifact paths so reviewers know this triage step.
Sam: Perfect. Closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
